name: cnntkd64-4b-qat
method: trained depthwise-separable CNN [16, 32, 48, 64] on a 64-view augmentation cache, BN folded, 4-bit codebook, flip TTA, QAT
notes: produced with an xl-teacher distillation loss, but a matched hard-label twin over the identical cache scores the same (val +0.52 pp, McNemar p=0.355; test ordering reverses) - the gain is the augmentation cache, not the loss. See docs/tta-and-distillation.md.
